Stingers

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Desperate for a cure to Lyme disease these women are stinging themselves with bees

Unique Selling Point:
Bee Venom treatment is a 3 year commitment to a rigours stinging and detoxing regime. Every second day 26-year-old Mica has to sting herself 10 times on her spine, but first she has to go and buy her bees for the week. After the stinging day she has to detox with special foods and a hot sauna. This isn't a get well quick fix, a last desperate attempt to get her life back

We go on this journey with her for a few days to experience it first hand.

Mica is following a program created by Ellie Lobel. She started her BVT regime years ago with the help of a DR friend
We also speak to and get Ellie in the usa to document her daily journey

Script:


Cinzia talking about calming the bees
Verite stinging – 3. 2. 1 STING
ARE YOU OKAY BABE
Cinzia
Josh always calms me down, so I know when it's coming, so I can just say it's not just like, yeah, you know, not like bam, bam, bam. It's like I can prepare for it.

VO: For 2 years Cinzia Govender has been sick, every two weeks she is down with a cold or stomach issues, she gets random pains in her joints and her feet. But mostly she is just exhausted all the time. And now as a last resort to get well she is trying bee venom

VERITE STINGING:
00:06:48:00 - 00:06:48:23
That one hurts.
00:06:52:04 - 00:06:53:23
No, it's not your fault. Thank you

I've probably seen a total of 11 doctors in the course of two years.
and every time they would find something new.
So I'd think, OK, great, we've got it. You know, we'll take the supplements, we'll change my diet, all of that. And then it just wouldn't go away. The fatigue would just never go away

I kept research And that's when I kept reading Lyme disease.
so I went back to my doctor
She found no Lyme, but she found a very similar bacteria called Kizzia,

Rickettsia are a group of bacteria mostly transmitted to humans via ticks. There are various strains around the world and some are more dangerous than others. Cinzia believes she was bitten when she lived in Costa Rico

so when I found out I had rickettsia I felt relief like I wasn't crazy, it's similar to lyme, it has the same symptoms and then comes the weight of.
I have a chronic tick borne disease that is incurable and managed by antibiotics.
Sorry I get emotional because you don't want to you don't want to be told you have an incurable disease at any age, you know, let alone two, three years into being married


VO: After undergoing various medical treatments including 5 months of antibiotics Cinzia found a Bee Venom protocol created by an American scientist with a phd in Nuclear physics, Ellie Lobel.

Upsound form youtube – hello and welcome …. Something something

Vo: Ellie had initially created this bee venom protocol to save her own life, after she lost her battle to Lyme disease, another tick born illness

After 15 years of fighting Lyme disease Ellie Lobel went into multiple organ failure, there was nothing left for anyone to do, so she moved to a forest to die. It was here that everything changed after she was stung by a swarm of bees.

Vo: Soon after being stung Ellie says she starting noticing that some of the symptoms of the Lyme disease were lifting

Bongani: what specific symptoms of Lyme disease suddenly were no longer the same as before?
ELLIE: the main thing that I noticed very soon after the attack was that the information had come down in my brain and that I could actually think straight.
00:50:03:22 - 00:50:22:12
So I started investigating the bee venom. I started investigating its components. I started investigating everything I could possibly find. You know, I didn't have anything else to do. I was waiting for death anyway.
00:50:23:08 - 00:50:47:05
So I started investigating and upon my investigation I found a small clinical trial that had been done by a laboratory that showed the venom literally destroyed this of bacteria in a petri dish,

Ellie spent two years with the help of colleagues researching the effects of Bee venom on the bacteria that was making her sick. She used herself as the experiment and slowly her Lyme disease symptoms started to go away.

I have been Lyme free going on seven years now
not even a some not even a glimpse hint of any Lyme

VO: Ellie now shares this bee venom protocol online, free of charge.

I am following Ellie’s protocol to the T.. Everything she says I do

00:23:14:16 - 00:23:27:16
Come on, little girl. That's why we have the little thingy on the top. OK, inside. Here we go
00:23:37:06 - 00:23:48:18
It's it's our pits. At first I felt like that, but then it was a bit weird. So I stopped

Cinzia: You sting yourself three times a week with a 48 hour rest period in between. So you can do Monday, Wednesday, Friday, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, up to you. As long as you have a consecutive to day break for detox, give your body a break just to get the venom out

01:06:55:05 - 01:07:31:16
So in layman's terms, they're very quick swimmers and they can get away pretty easy. The paralyzes the bacteria and starts pumping holes in all of its outer protective layers and then dismantles the bacteria.
So that's why it is so effective. That's why it's working. It's not allowing the bacteria to replicate itself. It's paralyzing. It's killing them. And that's it.

VO: Although there are studies being done around the world on the affects of bee venom on a range of illnesses. Globally from a medical and legal view point the use if bee venom is considered experimental.
Link: But according to Ellie it worked and Cinzia is hoping it will now work for her

00:56:11:08 - 00:56:41:10
Ellie: Some of the science is catching up. It's just taking time. And we do we do have we do have published science, peer reviewed, peer reviewed, published science on on the effects of really in the petri dish and on that. And now it's been in animal testing. It's an animal testing for three, three years now. And I say that.

VO: Using bee venom is a dangerous process. A person can develop Anaphylaxis or a bee allergy at any point so you always have to make sure you have an EpiPen with you before trying any protocol

a lot of people I've heard they sting in the car in front of a hospital if it's the first time and they're doing it on their own. I'm really blessed that Josh is here and helps, you know, so I don't have to do it alone.

In the USA using Bee Venom to heal is becoming big business, you can actually order your bees online and they will be delivered to your door, but in South Africa there is very little available so you basically have to take matters into your own hands.

Cinzia:
In South Africa, we catch our own bees. We do it. Old school.
00:44:17:18 - 00:44:45:08
This is the budget version. It's so it's the it is because we catch our own bees, we use one tweezer,
00:44:47:08 - 00:45:05:13
we're just making do with what we have for the moment seems to be working.


Cinzia started this Protocol in Augusts 2020 and although many of her symptoms have not gone away she does believe there has been a small change

CINZIA My better days are a lot more than the harder it is, that's for sure, and the fatigue is still there, but it's not as heavy as it was

Cinzia interviwe:
if it doesn't work. I don't I don't think that's not an option
00:42:01:11 - 00:42:07:11
because it has
it has to it's my only option right now.
